company.name: Sprout
company.shortDescription: Sprout makes wholesome, ready-to-heat food for children, crafted based on nutrition science, and loved by children and busy parents.
company.description: Sprout is a UAE-based food and nutrition startup focused on providing healthy, plant-based meals and snacks for babies, toddlers, and children. The company develops science-backed, nutrient-rich food products designed to encourage healthy eating habits from an early age. Its offerings include ready-to-eat meals, porridges, snacks, and frozen treats made with whole-food ingredients and without preservatives, refined sugars, or artificial additives.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $200,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,274,546 to $2,320,897, a 1.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 71 (+36 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
